disposition.ask: geodesic distance in meters from a coordinate to the nearest EPA mandatory Class I federal area
disposition.reason: Field directly measures geodesic distance in meters to the nearest Class I federal area (national parks / wilderness > 6000 acres).
disposition.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest EPA mandatory Class I federal area (national park / wilderness > 6000 acres); 0 when the point lies inside one.
disposition.interpretation_hints: A BTM gas plant clearing PSD major-source thresholds near a Class I area triggers mandatory Federal-Land-Manager consultation + visibility / air-quality-related-values modeling (customary screening ~300 km) — a lead-time and cost escalator distinct from nonattainment NNSR. Large or null far from any Class I area.

disposition.ask: name of the nearest Class I federal area
disposition.reason: Field directly provides the name of the nearest Class I federal area.
disposition.description: Name of the nearest Class I federal area (e.g. "Yosemite NP", "Sequoia NP").
disposition.interpretation_hints: The specific national park / wilderness whose Federal Land Manager would be consulted in PSD permitting. Null when no area is within the search radius.

disposition.ask: managing federal agency of the nearest Class I federal area
disposition.reason: Field directly identifies the Federal Land Manager (NPS, Forest Service, Fish & Wildlife Service, or BIA) for the nearest Class I area.
disposition.description: Managing federal agency of the nearest Class I area (USDI-NPS / USDA-FS / USDI-FWS / BIA).
disposition.interpretation_hints: Identifies which Federal Land Manager (National Park Service, Forest Service, Fish & Wildlife Service, or Bureau of Indian Affairs) governs the consultation. Null when no area is within the search radius.
